events.title: Watch Duty deploys Gemini across wildfire radio monitoring
events.title_zh: Watch Duty 将 Gemini 用于野火无线电监听
events.summary: Google and Watch Duty described a deployed transcription pipeline for roughly 400 active VHF wildfire radio feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day. The partners report word error rate falling from 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio and volunteer satisfaction rising from 35.3% to 92.3%. Humans still verify critical alerts before publication.
events.summary_en: Google and Watch Duty described a deployed transcription pipeline for roughly 400 active VHF wildfire radio feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day. The partners report word error rate falling from 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio and volunteer satisfaction rising from 35.3% to 92.3%. Humans still verify critical alerts before publication.

events.why_it_matters: This is a concrete high-noise, high-stakes deployment rather than a generic speech benchmark. It supports using models for triage while keeping humans responsible for consequential alerts; results come from a Google partner case study and lack independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: This is a concrete high-noise, high-stakes deployment rather than a generic speech benchmark. It supports using models for triage while keeping humans responsible for consequential alerts; results come from a Google partner case study and lack independent evaluation.

events.title: OpenAI reports stronger defenses against adversarial distillation
events.title_zh: OpenAI 公布对抗式蒸馏防护进展
events.summary: OpenAI described a layered defense against attempts to copy frontier-model capabilities through unauthorized distillation. It combines model training, classifiers, API protections and campaign investigation. In an internal adaptive evaluation, protected-reasoning extraction success fell from 54.0% on GPT-6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra. The evaluation and campaign data are publisher-run and are not independently reproducible from the release.
events.summary_en: OpenAI described a layered defense against attempts to copy frontier-model capabilities through unauthorized distillation. It combines model training, classifiers, API protections and campaign investigation. In an internal adaptive evaluation, protected-reasoning extraction success fell from 54.0% on GPT-6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra. The evaluation and campaign data are publisher-run and are not independently reproducible from the release.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布了一套针对未授权模型蒸馏的分层防护，结合模型训练、分类器、API 防护与协同行为调查。内部自适应评测中，受保护推理被提取的成功率从 GPT-6 Astra 原防护下的 54.0% 降至 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 0.2%。评测和行动数据均由发布方运行，无法依据本次材料独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For API and model-security teams, rate limits alone are not a sufficient extraction boundary. Request-level controls, model-side resistance and cross-account campaign analysis need to reinforce one another, while the headline metric still needs independent scrutiny.
events.why_it_matters_en: For API and model-security teams, rate limits alone are not a sufficient extraction boundary. Request-level controls, model-side resistance and cross-account campaign analysis need to reinforce one another, while the headline metric still needs independent scrutiny.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 API 与模型安全团队来说，单靠限流不足以阻止能力提取。请求级控制、模型自身抗提取能力与跨账户调查需要互相补强；核心数字仍需独立审查。

events.title: OpenAI releases MedChemBench for medicinal-chemistry reasoning
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布药物化学推理评测 MedChemBench
events.summary: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a 99-problem benchmark built from 117 papers and patents and 761 molecular structures. It tests structure reconstruction, evidence-based reasoning, compound selection and property prediction. OpenAI reports GPT-6.2 Astra at 84.5% available credit at xhigh, but the benchmark and reported model results come from the publisher and do not show clinical or drug-discovery success.
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a 99-problem benchmark built from 117 papers and patents and 761 molecular structures. It tests structure reconstruction, evidence-based reasoning, compound selection and property prediction. OpenAI reports GPT-6.2 Astra at 84.5% available credit at xhigh, but the benchmark and reported model results come from the publisher and do not show clinical or drug-discovery success.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 MedChemBench：99 道题来自 117 篇论文与专利，覆盖 761 个分子结构，测试结构重建、证据推理、化合物选择和性质预测。OpenAI 自报 GPT-6.2 Astra 在 xhigh 下获得 84.5% 可得分。评测与模型结果均由发布方提供，不能推导为临床或药物发现成功率。
events.why_it_matters: For scientific-agent evaluators, this offers a task set closer to medicinal-chemistry decisions than generic science QA. Teams should treat it as scoped evidence about representations and trade-off reasoning, not proof that a model can autonomously develop drugs.
events.why_it_matters_en: For scientific-agent evaluators, this offers a task set closer to medicinal-chemistry decisions than generic science QA. Teams should treat it as scoped evidence about representations and trade-off reasoning, not proof that a model can autonomously develop drugs.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对科学 agent 评测团队来说，它比通用科学问答更接近药物化学决策。它只能说明模型在结构表示和多目标权衡上的局部能力，不能证明模型能自主研发药物。

events.title: Independent tests find Inkling 2 Mini practical locally but uneven on tasks
events.title_zh: 独立实测显示 Inkling 2 Mini 本地可跑但能力不均
events.summary: Inkling 2 Mini is a roughly 26B-parameter looped MoE model with about 3B active parameters per token and public Apache 2.0 weights. Independent tests show it runs on local 16–64 GB hardware, but task quality varies: Plotly found strong data-analysis results with a costly runaway loop, while ITLab found weaker office and coding performance. These are single-run evaluations with different harnesses.
events.summary_en: Inkling 2 Mini is a roughly 26B-parameter looped MoE model with about 3B active parameters per token and public Apache 2.0 weights. Independent tests show it runs on local 16–64 GB hardware, but task quality varies: Plotly found strong data-analysis results with a costly runaway loop, while ITLab found weaker office and coding performance. These are single-run evaluations with different harnesses.
events.summary_zh: Inkling 2 Mini 是约 26B 参数的循环 MoE 模型，每个 token 激活约 3B 参数，权重采用 Apache 2.0。独立实测确认它可在 16–64 GB 本地硬件运行，但任务质量不均：Plotly 的数据分析成绩较好，却出现高成本失控循环；ITLab 的办公与代码任务较弱。两组结果都只跑了一次，且测试框架不同。
events.why_it_matters: For local-model teams, the model is operationally accessible, but quality and runaway-token risk now need workload-specific acceptance tests rather than publisher averages.
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-model teams, the model is operationally accessible, but quality and runaway-token risk now need workload-specific acceptance tests rather than publisher averages.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地模型团队来说，它已经具备可运行性，但任务质量与失控 token 风险必须按真实工作负载验收，不能只看厂商平均分。

technical_details.architecture: 24 physical decoder layers; middle 12 repeat three times for 48 layer applications; 8 of 128 experts per token
technical_details.size: about 26B total, about 3B active per token; roughly 20GB mixed NVFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint
technical_details.context: 1M tokens; text and image input, text output
technical_details.availability: Apache 2.0 weights; Apple silicon 32GB+, DGX Spark and other 32GB+ accelerators; multiple serving frameworks
technical_details.evidence_limit: Independent single-run evaluations with different tasks, runtimes and reasoning settings; scores are not directly comparable.
technical_details.time_basis: Model card and Hugging Face article give November 20, 2026 without time; no hourly-boundary claim is made
technical_details.independent_plotly: 36/43 hosted; 33/43 on an M4 Pro Mac mini; one runaway loop drove 179M tokens and a 69-second median per question in the hosted run.
technical_details.independent_itlab: 49-case ITLab Bench on a 16 GB RX 9070 XT: 72.4 low and 68.7 medium, below Swift Flash Next 94.6; failed to compile the M10 software project.
technical_details.time_basis_2026_11_29: Plotly published 2026-11-21; ITLab published 2026-11-24; both were consumed in the due seven-day review.

technical_details_zh.架构: 24 个物理 decoder layer；中间 12 层重复三次，共执行 48 层；每个 token 从 128 个专家中激活 8 个

technical_details_zh.2026-11-29 时间依据: Plotly 发布于 2026-11-21；ITLab 发布于 2026-11-24；本次到期七日复核纳入。

events.title: MiniMax releases code-backed automated cryptanalysis results
events.title_zh: MiniMax 发布带代码的自动密码分析结果
events.summary: MiniMax released papers and code for four cryptanalysis results that it says were primarily discovered by an internal model. The claims cover COLM forgery, TII McEliece challenge-key recovery, reduced-round ARADI attacks and SBC-VOLE secret-key recovery. Public artifacts make technical review possible, but the findings have not yet received independent cryptographic validation in this run.
events.summary_en: MiniMax released papers and code for four cryptanalysis results that it says were primarily discovered by an internal model. The claims cover COLM forgery, TII McEliece challenge-key recovery, reduced-round ARADI attacks and SBC-VOLE secret-key recovery. Public artifacts make technical review possible, but the findings have not yet received independent cryptographic validation in this run.
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布四项密码分析结果的论文和代码，并称这些结果主要由内部模型发现。目标包括 COLM 伪造、TII McEliece 挑战私钥恢复、ARADI 减轮攻击和 SBC-VOLE 私钥恢复。公开产物使技术复核成为可能，但本轮尚未核实到独立密码学验证。
events.why_it_matters: For AI-for-science and security teams, this moves beyond benchmark scores into inspectable research artifacts with potentially real protocol consequences. Claims about breaks and speedups require expert reproduction before any affected-system decision.
events.why_it_matters_en: For AI-for-science and security teams, this moves beyond benchmark scores into inspectable research artifacts with potentially real protocol consequences. Claims about breaks and speedups require expert reproduction before any affected-system decision.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 AI for Science 与安全团队来说，这不再只是 benchmark 分数，而是可能影响真实密码方案、且可检查的研究产物。任何受影响系统决策前，都必须由密码学专家独立复现攻击与复杂度。

events.title: Signal restricts mobile AI agents from capturing private conversations
events.title_zh: Signal 限制移动端 AI agent 截取私密对话
events.summary: Signal now blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and, when the operating system exposes detection, prevents AI assistants from capturing Signal screens on Android. Users can turn the Android protection off. The control does not cover every platform or filesystem access, so it reduces one exfiltration path rather than creating a complete agent sandbox.
events.summary_en: Signal now blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and, when the operating system exposes detection, prevents AI assistants from capturing Signal screens on Android. Users can turn the Android protection off. The control does not cover every platform or filesystem access, so it reduces one exfiltration path rather than creating a complete agent sandbox.

events.why_it_matters: Product teams building OS-level agents can no longer assume that user-granted screen access overrides every app boundary. Sensitive apps need explicit capture policy, while operating systems still lack a consistent app-level contract across screens, notifications and files.

events.title: DuckDB ships Sirius as a GPU core extension
events.title_zh: DuckDB 将 Sirius 作为 GPU 核心扩展发布
events.summary: DuckDB 2.0.1 made Sirius available as a core extension for GPU-accelerated analytical SQL on Linux with NVIDIA CUDA. Supported plans run on the GPU and unsupported queries fall back to DuckDB CPU execution. The extension is open source but downloads a large backend and has a limited operator surface.

events.title: Thinking Machines opens a variable-loop model for inference-time compute research
events.title_zh: Thinking Machines 开放可调循环次数的推理研究模型
events.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Apache-2.0 weights for TML-d24-varloop-research, a multimodal counterpart to Inkling 2 Mini whose shared layers can run one to five passes at inference time. The approximately 20GB checkpoint runs on a 32GB machine and exposes a direct quality-versus-compute control. Publisher evaluations show large gains from one to three passes, but later passes often plateau and training favored three passes.
events.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released Apache-2.0 weights for TML-d24-varloop-research, a multimodal counterpart to Inkling 2 Mini whose shared layers can run one to five passes at inference time. The approximately 20GB checkpoint runs on a 32GB machine and exposes a direct quality-versus-compute control. Publisher evaluations show large gains from one to three passes, but later passes often plateau and training favored three passes.
events.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 以 Apache-2.0 开放 TML-d24-varloop-research 权重。它是 Inkling 2 Mini 的多模态可变循环版本，推理时可让共享层运行 1 到 5 次；约 20GB checkpoint 可在 32GB 机器上运行。发布方评测显示从 1 次增加到 3 次通常提升明显，但继续增加常趋于平台期，而且训练本身偏重 3 次循环。
events.why_it_matters: Local-model teams can measure whether spending more inference compute helps each workload without loading different checkpoints. The uneven training schedule means the result is a research control, not proof that arbitrary extra loops reliably improve production quality.
events.why_it_matters_en: Local-model teams can measure whether spending more inference compute helps each workload without loading different checkpoints. The uneven training schedule means the result is a research control, not proof that arbitrary extra loops reliably improve production quality.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 本地模型团队可以不换 checkpoint，直接测同一任务增加推理计算是否值得。由于训练时不同循环次数的权重不均衡，它更像研究控制变量，不能证明生产环境里多循环一定更好。

events.title: MemTensor opens MemT-1.0-Pro with persistent latent memory
events.title_zh: MemTensor 开放带持久潜在记忆的 MemT-1.0-Pro
events.summary: MemTensor released OpenMDW-1.1 weights for MemT-1.0-Pro, a 554B-total, 59B-active model that updates a fixed-size latent memory across turns instead of retaining plaintext context. The publisher reports about 66x less state storage than a full 128K KV cache and ranks its family highest among evaluated parametric-memory methods. Strong text-retrieval memory systems still lead overall, and the very large checkpoint plus custom code make independent testing costly.
events.summary_en: MemTensor released OpenMDW-1.1 weights for MemT-1.0-Pro, a 554B-total, 59B-active model that updates a fixed-size latent memory across turns instead of retaining plaintext context. The publisher reports about 66x less state storage than a full 128K KV cache and ranks its family highest among evaluated parametric-memory methods. Strong text-retrieval memory systems still lead overall, and the very large checkpoint plus custom code make independent testing costly.
events.summary_zh: MemTensor 以 OpenMDW-1.1 开放 MemT-1.0-Pro 权重。模型总参数 554B、每 token 激活 59B，会在多轮交互中更新固定大小的潜在记忆，而不是保留明文上下文。发布方称它比完整 128K KV cache 少约 66 倍状态存储，并在所测参数化记忆方法中领先；但文本检索型记忆总体仍更强，超大 checkpoint 与自定义代码也让独立验证成本很高。
events.why_it_matters: Agent-memory teams get an inspectable alternative to replaying long plaintext histories, with explicit save-and-restore state. The license, custom code, hardware scale and publisher-only evaluation make it a research signal rather than a practical default.
events.why_it_matters_en: Agent-memory teams get an inspectable alternative to replaying long plaintext histories, with explicit save-and-restore state. The license, custom code, hardware scale and publisher-only evaluation make it a research signal rather than a practical default.
events.why_it_matters_zh: agent memory 团队多了一个不必反复回放长明文历史、还能显式保存和恢复状态的开放方案。许可、自定义代码、硬件规模和厂商自测意味着它目前只是研究信号，不是实用默认选项。

events.title: AI SAGE publishes GigaChat4 708B weights with 41B active parameters
events.title_zh: AI SAGE 发布 GigaChat4 708B 权重，激活参数为 41B
events.summary: AI SAGE published MIT-licensed FP8, BF16, base, GGUF and checkpoint repositories for GigaChat4-708B-A41B. The mixture-of-experts model has 708B total and 41B active parameters, advertises a 1M-token context window, tool use and structured output, and uses hybrid linear and sparse attention. The artifacts are public, but the hardware requirement is extreme and independent capability evidence is limited.
events.summary_en: AI SAGE published MIT-licensed FP8, BF16, base, GGUF and checkpoint repositories for GigaChat4-708B-A41B. The mixture-of-experts model has 708B total and 41B active parameters, advertises a 1M-token context window, tool use and structured output, and uses hybrid linear and sparse attention. The artifacts are public, but the hardware requirement is extreme and independent capability evidence is limited.

events.why_it_matters: The release is technically inspectable and unusually large for open weights, yet most teams cannot validate it cheaply enough to justify a POC today.

events.title: Kintsugi-27B squeezes Qwen3.8-27B into a 12 GB GPU
events.title_zh: Kintsugi-27B 将 Qwen3.8-27B 压进 12 GB GPU
events.summary_en: Kintsugi-27B is a 2.47-bits-per-weight Qwen3.8-27B build designed to keep a 262,144-token context on one 12 GB GPU through a custom llama.cpp fork. Apache 2.0 weights, runtime bundles, hashes and benchmark scripts are public. The author reports near-BF16 agent results, but controlled independent reproduction is still missing.
events.summary: Kintsugi-27B is a 2.47-bits-per-weight Qwen3.8-27B build designed to keep a 262,144-token context on one 12 GB GPU through a custom llama.cpp fork. Apache 2.0 weights, runtime bundles, hashes and benchmark scripts are public. The author reports near-BF16 agent results, but controlled independent reproduction is still missing.
events.summary_zh: Kintsugi-27B 是 Qwen3.8-27B 的 2.47 bits-per-weight 版本，依靠定制 llama.cpp fork，把 262,144 token 上下文放进一张 12 GB GPU。Apache 2.0 权重、runtime bundle、哈希和 benchmark 脚本均已公开。作者报告其 agent 表现接近 BF16，但尚无受控独立复现。
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-agent teams, a full 27B model with long context becomes testable on commodity GPUs, but the fork-only runtime and publisher-run benchmarks create operational and evidence risk.
events.why_it_matters: For local-agent teams, a full 27B model with long context becomes testable on commodity GPUs, but the fork-only runtime and publisher-run benchmarks create operational and evidence risk.
